primary_issues: Platforms report 1,480 conversions vs 950 actual (56% overcounting)
TikTok missing CAPI - estimated 30-40% data loss on iOS
Attribution windows inconsistent: Google 30d, Meta 7d, TikTok 28d
View-through attribution inflating Meta and TikTok numbers

ga4_integration.assessment: FAIR - UTM gaps causing attribution holes

critical_gaps.impact: 30-40% of TikTok conversions not tracked on iOS devices
critical_gaps.fix: Implement TikTok Events API via Shopify app or direct integration

critical_gaps.impact: ~10-15% potential data loss on advanced matching
critical_gaps.fix: Improve by sending more user parameters (phone, city, state)

critical_gaps.impact: Some conversions show as Direct in GA4
critical_gaps.fix: Audit all campaigns for UTM consistency, use auto-tagging where possible

sales_cycle_alignment.assessment: Google and TikTok windows are longer than needed, Meta is appropriate
sales_cycle_alignment.impact: Google and TikTok over-claiming conversions outside realistic window

window_comparison_issue.problem: Can't fairly compare platforms with 7d vs 28d vs 30d windows
window_comparison_issue.example: Google claims a conversion from 25 days ago that Meta wouldn't
window_comparison_issue.impact: Google appears more efficient than it may actually be

google.rationale: Matches sales cycle, enables fair comparison with Meta

meta.rationale: View-through is inflating numbers; consider click-only for cleaner data

tiktok.rationale: Align with other platforms, view-through at 7 days is aggressive

attribution_window_analysis.standardization_benefit: With all platforms at 7-day click, you can compare apples-to-apples

ga4_comparison.assessment: GA4 is close to truth but slightly under due to tracking gaps

why_platforms_overcount: View-through attribution: User sees ad, buys later, platform claims credit
Multi-platform journeys: User sees Meta ad, clicks Google ad, both claim credit
Long windows: Google and TikTok counting conversions weeks after interaction
iOS data loss: May cause some duplicate counting via modeled conversions
analysis.meta_specific: 89% overcount vs GA4 suggests heavy reliance on view-through and modeled conversions
analysis.tiktok_specific: 112% overcount suggests aggressive view-through (7-day window) and modeled data filling gaps from missing CAPI

true_contribution_estimate.methodology: Using GA4 as baseline (closer to truth than platform data)
true_contribution_estimate.caveat: GA4 also has attribution biases (favors last-click channels)

meta.mitigation: CAPI at 72% EMQ - could be better
meta.improvement_opportunity: Improve EMQ to 80%+ to recover ~5% more data

tiktok.improvement_opportunity: CAPI implementation could recover 20-30% of lost data

recommended_approach.primary: Standardized 7-day click attribution across all platforms
recommended_approach.secondary: Use GA4 as neutral source of truth for cross-platform comparison
recommended_approach.advanced: Consider incrementality tests if budget allows

model_reasoning.why_click_only: View-through is contributing to overcounting, especially Meta and TikTok
model_reasoning.why_ga4_as_truth: More neutral than platform data, though still imperfect

recommended_hierarchy.why: Use to optimize campaigns but don't compare across platforms

how_to_reconcile.step_1: Use Shopify total orders as the 'true' conversion count
how_to_reconcile.step_2: Use GA4 source breakdown to estimate each channel's contribution
how_to_reconcile.step_3: Use platform data only for optimizing within that platform (which ads, audiences, etc.)
how_to_reconcile.step_4: Don't compare Google's reported ROAS to Meta's reported ROAS directly
